name: tag-input
title: Tag input
description: Short free-form values as tags: Enter, comma or Tab adds, a pasted list adds them all, Backspace twice removes the last; duplicates and invalid values are said, not dropped silently.
whenToUse: Free-form short values such as labels or email addresses.

keyboard: Backspace marks then removes the last
spec.motion: A new tag grows in, the others close up when one is removed, and the removed tag fades where it stood (useFlip, --pui-duration-standard). Reduced motion places at once.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Classes for documented visual parts; internal refs and event handlers are retained.

props.name: style / ref
props.description: Visual root style; ref targets native input.

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style address the visual root; typed classNames style the documented parts. Native control refs and controller identities survive appearance changes.
